In contrast to 2006 Q24, no F=p-dot and operational work/velocity linkage are provided. REJECT confirmed consistently with the original arbitrary-Hamiltonian decisions.

Focused fixed spatial geometry review: complete Q9 p3 reread. Hyperbolic plane specifies a constant-curvature mathematical space up to a scale. One can choose its metric/embedded constraint, apply local Newton acceleration/potential gradients and obtain isometry conservations by differentiating geometry, without requiring a remembered Noether/canonical law. The task permits constructing gravity/oscillator variants, rather than prescribing an unsupplied gravitational spacetime theory. Whole KEEP confirmed; metric/potential conventions must be stated.

Focused full supplied-elastic-PDE review: all stress convolution, isotropic C and motion equations Q11 p3 reopened. The actual constitutive kernel and rho*u-double-dot=div(sigma) supply both specialized physical laws. Infinitesimal strain is the symmetric gradient obtained by differentiating displaced line-element lengths, a kinematic calculation. Fourier projections give rho*omega_L^2/k^2=lambda0*alpha_hat+2*mu0*beta_hat and rho*omega_T^2/k^2=mu0*beta_hat; hence both unknown kernels follow the supplied dispersion. KEEP confirmed; this differs from cases naming a tensor while omitting constitutive/dynamical laws.

Focused complete PDE and analytic closure review: intact Q30 p6 equation reread. Put psi=A*exp(i*S/hbar) on a continuous phase branch. The printed logarithmic term becomes k*S*psi; imaginary and real parts give continuity and S-dot+|grad S|^2/(2m)+U-(hbar^2/2m)*(Laplacian A/A)+k*S=0. Gradient therefore gives drag -k*grad S. For static U and vanishing boundary flux, integration by parts gives dE/dt=-(k/m)*integral(A^2*|grad S|^2)<=0 for the natural supplied-PDE quadratic energy. Stationary A profiles follow its real eigen-equation with the corresponding phase ODE. All are mathematical consequences of the full operational model; no Born measurement, Pauli/ladder or missing quantum evolution rule is needed. KEEP confirmed, with source phase/global-energy convention disclosed.

Focused supplied Arrhenius equilibrium review: entire Q31 p6 reread and operational thermal/Boltzmann scope checked. Product n_e*n_h=N_e*N_h*exp(-(E1+E2)/(kT)) supplies the equilibrium population constant; its temperature slope gives pair energy for constant prefactors, with reversed sign for recombination. An alternative kinetic-rate interpretation is underdetermined by equilibrium data, which can be stated rather than adding quantum semiconductor kinetics. Whole KEEP confirmed with reference concentration/prefactor convention explicit.
